definition.simple: The nucleus is the boss or the brain of the cell that tells it what to do.
definition.academic: A membrane-bound organelle that contains the cell's chromosomes and controls cellular activities.

examples: The dark spot seen inside a cheek cell under a microscope
The center of a white blood cell

common_misconceptions: Every cell has a nucleus (bacteria do not).
The nucleus is just an empty space.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Compare the nucleus to the principal of a school or the CPU of a computer.
